scripts.build: bun run check:public-boundary && turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' --concurrency=2
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/strict-json test && bun test
scripts.test:package: bun run --cwd packages/strict-json build && bun run --cwd packages/strict-json test:package && bun run --cwd packages/llm-core test:package && bun run --cwd packages/aifsd test:package
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd packages/strict-json lint && bun run --cwd packages/llm-core lint && bun run --cwd packages/aifsd lint && bun run lint:apps && eslint "scripts/**/*.{ts,js}" "examples/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}" "docs/snippets/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}" --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern
scripts.typecheck:packages: bun run --cwd packages/strict-json typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/llm-core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/aifsd typecheck && bun run contracts:schema:check
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:packages && bun run typecheck:apps && bun run typecheck:examples && bun run docs:snippets:typecheck
scripts.docs:check: bun run scripts/check-docs.ts && bun run docs:snippets:typecheck
scripts.typecheck:examples: bun tsc -p examples/agentic/client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun tsc -p examples/agentic/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun tsc -p examples/kitchen-sink/client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun tsc -p examples/kitchen-sink/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:tests: bun run --cwd packages/strict-json typecheck:tests && bun run --cwd packages/llm-core typecheck:tests
scripts.release:repo-check: bun run check:public-boundary && eslint "scripts/**/*.{ts,js}" "examples/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}" "docs/snippets/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}" --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern && bun run contracts:schema:check && bun run typecheck:examples && bun run docs:check && bun run check:sloc
scripts.release:checks:llm-core: turbo run lint typecheck typecheck:tests test format:check --filter=@aifsd/strict-json --filter=@geekist/llm-core --filter=@aifsd/sdk --concurrency=2 && turbo run "//#release:repo-check" --concurrency=1
scripts.release:package-smoke:llm-core: bun run --cwd packages/strict-json test:package && bun run --cwd packages/llm-core test:package:prebuilt
scripts.release:version:check: bun run release:version:check:strict-json && bun run release:version:check:llm-core && bun run release:version:check:aifsd && bun run release:provenance:validate
scripts.release:qualify:aifsd: bun run --cwd packages/aifsd release:build && bun run --cwd packages/aifsd test:package:prebuilt
